## 1. Prediction market

**The gap narrows by 2.00 points.** In the confirmed reading of October 22 at 17:56 BRT, the [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) pays 77.70% for Flávio Bolsonaro (USD 24.89M) and 22.50% for Lula (USD 28.54M). Against the confirmed reading of October 21 at 18:28 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro falls 1.00pp and Lula rises 1.00pp; since the pair's sum stays at 100.20, the normalized move equals the raw one. The gap goes from 57.20pp to 55.20pp. The total volume accumulated in the presidential book is USD 191.89M, and the largest volume in the book is still Lula's.

**Supreme Court and inflation.** The contract on the [impeachment of an STF justice before 2027](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) stands at 3.30% (USD 0.10M), 0.25pp below the reading of October 21. In the [2026 inflation](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026) contract, in the 18:16 BRT reading against the one of October 21 at 18:37 BRT, the 5.00% to 5.49% range goes from 71.20% to 70.70% (USD 28 thousand), the 5.50% to 5.99% range from 14.60% to 14.00% (USD 21 thousand) and the 4.50% to 4.99% range from 11.30% to 11.70% (USD 33 thousand).

## 2. What the polling firms registered

**Three new national polls.** [PoderData/Aya](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPMmNIdmNwU0FGR2tZYW0yM1ZNWV81Qm5RUE1RbWhhNGhMQlYtTXJtcXVPTEwtdVZnRUNiN1NaSVFrRzR5WGZXOWtWaG1oRm1FVTl4dlZzOEZ0WkJjNEpmQjh6NTd3cWlYall0N3VmTU9yV3NVSlFNejBMYzhXOEZEZ2E0N25VcUNkOXhNcjhZa2FjSEd2NWswM3Iwd0xNblZxejcxc0dsTGNwZw?oc=5), with 4,000 telephone interviews from October 19 to 21, gives 49% to Flávio Bolsonaro and 48% to Lula in total votes and [51% to 49% in valid votes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOVm11RkRYNy1pTWk1NElpN2QxWE05eUk4RlhaeGhBTUxUdjFYS29kd24xNzRSUjJZMjZQbEdDLUcwN2trb3kzYlJydXMwTjRPWko1VXB6MTJjSGdEdWVmaXh6cHBRMkN6WUoxamd2dXhocTdSWHNXOGJZTTlKR29Ob0ZoTXByNU5aVUhTOXN5bGJlYWdmb2Mya25pelFlcHM?oc=5). **Round against round.** Against each pollster's previous round, the distance in Flávio Bolsonaro's favor in total votes falls from 3 to 1 point in [PoderData/Aya](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxPTEZCejBXTFpES2lBbjlza0tRcm1PdmpSUmVwdEN3THlINzgySEVobXVsN0hXV19hQkRzR2tTU19DVHpwcjItY0lXVVdrUnhrVnA2LUdGc2NOU01hNU9uZzVqVm5kSGJBTXJsTG5OcWR6NjFuQVh2ekpxRFp1Uk9taE96NXEweXdwQVEwbDQ0NUQ0U1ZwbVB3Vm5zNjl2b3ZUMnNr?oc=5) and from 1.5 to 1.1 points in [Indexa/Broadcast](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxPQ1daT2liNVp5MnhGSG1xWVdTNm56MDFVcnB5cUZYN1R3U3ZRcDJUeUFxd0E2LUdHeGRzakZGVzgySi1vNTBtVGJzVXNhUURjRmtGbmJOYVdGVnpDaHRPQ0lqc3FMMUxkU1Npc3pESFBGcDVKZlVKNFdZYkVaMWkzWGVyWkVkMC1DbjNseE5RckFJLTM5OWhZWmtqUWVtN0xkMlhSbDBKeDUxdkZYb3U1dk9TeDZDeHVHaXBRUDVVdk5iREpkalFCMmpyeXhtdw?oc=5); in valid votes, it rises from 4 to 6 points in Gerp. In PoderData/Aya, 47% would never vote for Lula and 45% would never vote for Flávio Bolsonaro. Of the thirty-six national polls conducted after the first round, thirty-three put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead; the two Vox Brasil polls put Lula ahead, and PoderData/Aya of October 16 measured a tie in valid votes. The poll side of the panel's chart is now PoderData/Aya, the largest sample of the day. The Datafolha poll with fieldwork from October 20 to 22 has its release registered with the TSE for October 22.

## 3. What the press covered

**The secrecy.** On October 22, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro signed at the TSE a document authorizing the lifting of their bank, tax and phone secrecy, according to [Valor](https://news.google.?oc=5) and [Folha de S.Paulo](https://news.google.?oc=5), and the release of the documents is up to Justice André Mendonça, according to [Congresso em Foco](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNYkZxbF9XYkVrUU90UUIyNmVvVzl5R2JRMy1SMVZ3WFhwS3dlVGdwUE5hZGJFQzAyOUdrLXlKT040eG9wZkFqMWx2QmlnS0ZoM0JyUWl1OG5sMVJLUUVtbmx1dS1EZE5heFZxYkhITlRxaHRqX2V6Z2ZHZ0tqZGZoUkdyaTZ3ZTVXQk9fcWgzWTZKNUtlM05waFl4eVppZWJZdWx0WGN0NWFjNS1SR2hzTnhRTWo?oc=5). Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign says it will only hand over his data after analyzing Lula's, according to [JOTA](https://news.google.?oc=5) and [Exame](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPeS16YVhvTDNuZWlGcGxTZnlyTXdTQ01feGpTVExGbXBsYldrM0s0NUtZWmFsM29nZ0ZsWjFoaGJkWlV4TDlUMEJTd0NsbTlScmlWZDY2Zi02UWFFMF83R0d5UlowUmc4OTU1c0lJaldVdFZxNXlHejd5d0tNT0l4dEpmZWpIR2x2X3hpZ2JKNkgzSVh5QzZnRU9NRW81T0ljTHpSZzRxQm9kMXRwbG1sMEJqdUUyYi1IWHVGeQ?oc=5), and assigned Deltan Dallagnol to that analysis, according to [Valor](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5).

**The government messages.** Justice Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, the TSE's inspector general, denied in an injunction ruling the request by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign to suspend government messages sent via WhatsApp and Gov.br, among them notices about Bolsa Família and the INSS proof-of-life check, considering them of apparently informative content, according to [CartaCapital](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPOXE1TlJVcEpUaUdtNllFOW5fa0NQc0JYdGcyRWxpWGpIXzdRb2VyVEZ1NW5xX29UTGZZRWxrbWk0TGptWTgyd3ZoZjIxSXptY2xNaWt4aEwzR0ZCSjF1dk9FWmI0RE1MYV9kQnlzSXJRWU1reUtXY09Xb2daLVk4QmRRaUEzWWJwdDJUYS1XU1RVd3M5UmI0eU1kT3VERW5kYzRxUldabHZ0Wk9XLV9fRWpyZGg?oc=5) and [G1](https://g1.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/10/22/corregedor-do-tse-nega-pedido-de-flavio-bolsonaro-para-suspender-mensagens-do-governo.ghtml). The justice gave the parties five days to respond.

**Meta and the debate.** The TSE president, Kassio Nunes Marques, gave Meta 24 hours to submit a detailed report on coordinated actions in the Exército do Lula channel, according to [Folha de S.Paulo](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/10/kassio-manda-meta-apresentar-em-24-horas-relatorio-detalhado-sobre-acoes-do-exercito-de-lula.shtml) and [Valor](https://news.google.?oc=5). Globo's debate, the last before the vote, is scheduled for the night of October 23, with limits on the candidates' movement in the studio, according to [Folha de S.Paulo](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/10/debate-da-globo-entre-lula-e-flavio-tera-quatro-blocos-e-restricao-a-movimentacao-veja-regras.shtml) and [CartaCapital](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPM2ZVWi0yR2VmUl9JMERZcHNZM2xqSnpGQVpCZHp5MTE3aXFpVHo2QUhiUHNEVk41bEowQVltZThJZjZxbGhjMkpidTdWaU5NbGxBOEJWYnpydDJpbTl3dEV1NWtyNkVyZmRjQ3dBV0VLQWtzdUl2ZjBJQjZweUNxQTM2Nm5UN0hVbEsyVlJxRjdINU1oazc3M1pCYXpscjJqRkR5VHl5MVc?oc=5).

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market × polls:** the [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) pays 77.70% for Flávio Bolsonaro, and the three new national polls put him ahead by 1 to 5 points in total votes, with margins of 1.6 to 2.2. Price measures the probability of winning on October 25, and the poll measures voting intention during each one's fieldwork.

> **Poll × poll:** with fieldwork ending on October 21, the distance in Flávio Bolsonaro's favor falls in [PoderData/Aya](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPMmNIdmNwU0FGR2tZYW0yM1ZNWV81Qm5RUE1RbWhhNGhMQlYtTXJtcXVPTEwtdVZnRUNiN1NaSVFrRzR5WGZXOWtWaG1oRm1FVTl4dlZzOEZ0WkJjNEpmQjh6NTd3cWlYall0N3VmTU9yV3NVSlFNejBMYzhXOEZEZ2E0N25VcUNkOXhNcjhZa2FjSEd2NWswM3Iwd0xNblZxejcxc0dsTGNwZw?oc=5) and Indexa/Broadcast and rises in Gerp.

> **Release × registration:** the [Gerp](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxOZ3FoQWpVUW9lTFlwWnk5N2FrU3BTdlR5eGRKR25oM1ZvMlhIM1hrV3RfdDFkVXFNOFVVMmpRTE9tUmxUMko0OUl2QXQ3TmpBWkV5anBFNXpYVTMzRXFUVGxRTUlHMERXdjY0cDN3cS1mcURZQ3dfc3VVbnhzVW4waE5vTzctclM1RG0tcWdB?oc=5) releases give fieldwork from October 19 to 21, and the poll's TSE registration lists fieldwork from October 17 to 20.

## In summary

1. **The three new national polls put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead by 1 to 5 points in total votes**, and thirty-three of the thirty-six conducted after the vote put him in front.
2. **The [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) takes Flávio Bolsonaro from 78.70% to 77.70%**, and the gap goes from 57.20pp to 55.20pp.
3. **The candidates signed at the TSE the document to lift their secrecy**, and the release depends on a decision by Justice André Mendonça.
